Subject: Kickoff: Sprint 0 & owner introductions for Everwell Labs

Hi Alyssa / Mark — great to have Everwell Labs officially onboarded. Attaching the signed SOW (Everwell_SOW_v2.pdf) and a lightweight Sprint 0 outline (Sprint0-outline.xlsx) so we can align on the first 2 weeks.

High-level success criteria for Sprint 0 (what we need to get to yes for implementation):
- API access established and test keys provided (stage)
- Sample dataset loaded (anonymized) and schema validated
- Security questionnaire items scoped and initial evidence requested
- Kickoff session with engineering and product owners scheduled

Proposed owners (tentative):
- Customer Success lead: Sofia Ivanova (onboarding, acceptance criteria)
- Security & compliance: Monica Patel (evidence collection, SCG)
- Technical integration: Karthik Iyer (API, infra coordination)

Can you confirm a preferred kickoff window the week of Dec 6 or Dec 13, and share a primary data contact and an initial list of IPs/allowlist constraints? I’ll hand this thread over to Sofia to coordinate the CS plan.

Thanks — excited to get going.

—Ben

Quick notes:
- Procurement (cc’d) will route the final invoice and PO request this week. Expect a 7–10 business day turnaround.
- Our data owner is Mark Donovan (cc’d). He will coordinate sample data extraction and provide an anonymized CSV by Dec 10.

Alyssa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 10:27:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: Everwell - pre-handoff notes / clarifications

[Internal notes — do not forward verbatim to customer]
Couple of points from the sales side to flag for CS before kickoff:
- Scope nuance: Customer asked for a sample reranking POC in Sprint 0; this is out-of-the-box but we should limit to a nondeterministic scoring demo vs full retrain. Budget for extra tokens is limited — call this out in acceptance criteria.
- Billing: Signed SOW has a short "pilot supplement" clause. If we exceed 200k tokens in Sprint 0, sales will handle a make-good credit; need telemetry to surface token usage daily.
- Network: Everwell will likely require static egress IPs and a short-term allowlist; engineering needs to plan for this.
- Compliance: They requested a subset of SOC 2 artifacts up-front (data retention policy, encryption at rest config). Monica, can you draft a 1-page starter pack and the security-checklist.pdf?

Suggested owner roster (attached as Everwell_owner_roster.csv):
- CS lead / primary: Sofia (customer onboarding, success plan, acceptance)
- Security & compliance POC: Monica (evidence collection, audit gating)
- Integration lead: Karthik (API keys, test environment, performance knobs)

Sofia — take the lead on scheduling internal pre-kick and customer kickoff. I’ll stay on the thread for the first customer meeting.

—Ben

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Sprint 0 & owner introductions for Everwell Labs

Thanks Ben / Alyssa — I’ll take point for onboarding and confirm owners. Proposed plan:
- Internal pre-kick: Dec 7, 10:00 AM PST (30m) — internal alignment on scope and data requirements
- Customer kickoff: Dec 13, 9:00 AM PST (60m) — introductions, success criteria, sprint 0 goals, initial tasks

Agenda (customer kickoff):
1) Introductions & key contacts
2) Sprint 0 goals & acceptance criteria (Ben / Sofia)
3) Data readiness & sample dataset plan (Mark / Karthik)
4) Security evidence & timelines (Monica)
5) Logistics: allowlist, staging access, credentials, and token monitoring

Alyssa / Mark — can you confirm the customer kickoff time (Dec 13, 9am PST) and whether Mark can share the anonymized sample by Dec 10? Also, please confirm whether procurement prefers an initial invoice now or after Sprint 0 acceptance.

I’ve created a shared folder for artifacts (link in thread). I’ll run the internal pre-kick this morning and send invites.

—Sofia
